title: FEATURE REQ:  Automatic redaction algorithm for privacy sensitive geolocations.
body: Assign a uniquely identifiable score for a pair of (user, geocoordinate). The higher the score is, the higher should be probability of removal of the points.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: This also might make sense on the Contact Tracer side.  I think there is a balancing act of personal privacy and public health concern.  Perhaps we allow the user to decide to Share an auto-redacted (client side) OR to share a full history that they will go through with a trusted Contact Tracer.

comments.author: Participant 3
Participant 4
comments.body: If we work by % time spent in the same place (i.e. house/office) we could suggest something like "hey, you spent a lot of time in this area, do you want to remove it from the shared records?" (or something better formulated)

comments.author: Participant 5
comments.body: Closing this issue out as we have taken it into consideration and documented the feedback on [this page in Jira](https://pathcheck.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SAFE/pages/81265028/GitHub+Issues+-+Community+Feature+Requests).

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
